posted_body:
The first original full-image check on the floor-corrected `248ed178` shader inputs did **not** complete. `KernelTrace.KerrRenderIsFiniteNonConstantWithBoundedShadow` stopped at the unchanged sampled 4 GiB ownership guard after 162.646503410 s.

The final sampled aggregate was 4,200,404 KiB: child 4,174,784 plus controller 25,620, exceeding 4,194,304 by 6,100 KiB. The owner terminated the child with SIGTERM, recorded exit -15, and retired the observed PID/start identity without cleanup errors or remaining processes. All 1,210 before/after input identities remained current and equal; the actual LVP mapping and default cache policy were bound.

The log contains only the original GoogleTest start. There is no completed image, image metric, numerical shader verdict or test XML. `KernelTrace.Fp64RungAgreesWithFp32OnKerrScene` was not launched because the sequence stops on the first nonpass. The original 64x64 parameters/assertions, 64-active-row bound, physical 1000 ms checks and 4 GiB/2 GiB ownership boundaries were unchanged. The prospective whole-test wall was diagnostic; this was not the separate cold retained-Kerr 300 s gate.

[Immutable incomplete result and producer aliases](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/0abce0ad6943d06e391b45e2f5bece092f802b25/attestations/scientific-core/248ed17/kernel-trace-original-image-rss-stop/result.json), tag `evidence/issue-53-kernel-trace-original-image-rss-stop`: 43 files; manifest SHA256 `da298005a15c6c31777737becf5a5fcefdc9870a15cf175c982b324c9ab3bf9a`. Independent review records attempt `passed=false`, audit completed and valid ownership. The 30-file diagnostics were Git-preserved and retired after remote verification.

The RSS peak does not identify an allocation or executing phase, and the previous 11d17cc diagnostic stop remains unresolved. Parity-probe floor controls are not proof of full-trace initialization memory viability. No unchanged retry, cache change, raised guard or substituted image is accepted. The separately preserved four passing retained-sampler/conservation controls in `1cda8a97` remain valid; full-image, precision comparison, full CI, native domains and release qualification remain incomplete.
